title: Chapter 177
text:
The White Lion King leaped up and used its ability to kill.

The wind was close to his head, but Han Xiao's expression did not change. He aimed his arm at the sky and activated the repulsive field driver. An invisible repulsive wave shot out from his wrist, and the White Lion King was pushed up into the air, landing heavily on the ground.

Han Xiao activated many modules, and the energy of the mechanical suit slowly decreased.

After countless punches, the White Lion King's health dropped to about thirty percent. The White Lion King roared at the sky, and its skin turned blood red. It entered a stronger state of rage. If it were a player, it would be entering the second stage. Han Xiao felt the pressure suddenly increase.

"It's best not to fight head-on in rage." Han Xiao chose to avoid it and retreated. Being able to fight and run was his battle style.

After chasing for a while, the White Lion King slowed down and showed signs of fatigue.

At this time, the cooldown of [Flaming Will] was over. Han Xiao picked up the Ghost sniper rifle and fired at the other eye of the Mutant White Lion King.

This was the highest multiplier of [Flaming Will], 4.1 times!

Oh my god!

With one shot, the remaining eye exploded. The White Lion King was heavily injured and fell into the dust, unable to move. It only had a few hundred health points left.

"It's dead!" Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief. The modified version of Viper was much more powerful than he had expected. It made up for the weakness of the Mechanic's physical attributes, and it was more reliable in close combat. Furthermore, it was very comprehensive.

Viper was the cornerstone of the second battle plan. Just like how the sniper style was slowly taking shape, the mechanical suit also needed to be perfected with new modules. It was currently just a prototype. This battle was a practical test. Han Xiao secretly analyzed the direction of the modification of the mechanical suit. There was room for improvement in long-range, close combat, and stealth.

Han Xiao finished off the White Lion King, took out his Retractable Knife, and dug out the heart of the Mutant White Lion King. It was the size of a basketball and covered in purple blood vessels.

You have received special item [Mutant Heart] x1

You have triggered the mission [Virus Research]!

Mission Introduction: All the beasts in this area are infected by the Death Virus. Some organizations need samples that are strong enough for research. That's right, I'm talking about the heart in your hand.

Mission Requirements: Deliver the [Mutated Heart] to the Louis Institute of Biological Research within seven days.

Reward: 1 Death Virus Potion

This quest was an additional reward triggered by the heart. Handing over the heart would grant a potion that permanently increased one's attributes. There was also a chance to awaken a rare talent.

In Shi Feng's previous life, every time a Beast King Boss spawned in the Laubert area, it would be hunted down and killed by players within a few hours. Because the potion made from the Death Virus could be used repeatedly, the large guilds had always occupied the area to farm these monsters.

The Louis Biological Research Institute was a public large-scale biological research institute. Players could use all sorts of strange materials to exchange for the same strange potions. Some of the potions were sold openly, and it was located in Maple.

Han Xiao took out the prepared liquid nitrogen metal box and put the lion's heart inside. At this time, Yang Dian and Ned walked up hesitantly as they heard footsteps.

"Thank you for your help." Yang Dian studied Viper's modified visor curiously. Unfortunately, he couldn't see Han Xiao's face.

Han Xiao didn't say anything. He checked his ammo and armor, then got up and left. The smell of blood here would attract wild beasts. He needed to find a place to rest quickly.

The two of them looked at each other awkwardly and understood each other's intentions. They hurriedly caught up to Han Xiao, introduced themselves, and said hopefully, "We came to the Robert Forbidden Zone to save an exploration team. In order to solve the problem of the virus, they entered deep into the Robert Forbidden Zone alone and have lost contact with them. We hope you can help us."

You have triggered a Level D Mission [Save the Exploration Team]. Do you accept?

"Reject."

Han Xiao waved his hand and adjusted his voice to a synthetic voice. "Don't bother me."

The success rate of saving people was too low. The longer they stayed in the area, the more danger they would be in. Han Xiao's only goal was the mutated heart. He had already completed his goal, so there was no need to waste time. He didn't want to be led by the nose by the mission.

"They're in danger because of the virus. How can you leave them in the lurch?" Ned said anxiously.

Han Xiao activated his hover-boots and left. His meaning was clear. You can do whatever you want, but don't involve me.

The two of them watched helplessly as Han Xiao left.

Not everyone was as kind as them. The two understood that, but they could only regret that they had lost a powerful helper.

…

After leaving the Laubert Forbidden Area, Han Xiao returned to the transport plane parked far away. He took off his mechanical suit and heaved a sigh of relief.

Viper's performance was excellent. He was very satisfied with the results.

The plane took off, and the next stop was Maple. Contact Louis Research Institution, exchange the heart for medicine, and complete the threat mission. The contact of the Blood Pact Society was also in Maple.

Han Xiao looked at the mission brief on the computer.

My contacts are two assassins. Hmm? This name sounds familiar. Golden Fox? I think I've seen it somewhere.

Han Xiao raised an eyebrow but didn't think much of it. He opened the forums and focused on the problems of the players.

There were still two novice villages left in the Western Continent, and the newbies there were crying piteously for food. The average level of the players was almost LV 10. At this stage in Han Xiao's previous life, they had already started to leave the novice villages on a large scale. However, because of Han Xiao's existence, a portion of the players obediently stayed in the novice villages, waiting for Han Xiao's arrival.

This felt great. His actions had indirectly influenced the behavior of the players. It was all thanks to his actions during this period of time that he had gained a certain amount of influence among the players.

Looking at the forums, a few new posts caught his attention. Most of the people who posted were players from the Andrea Continent, complaining.

"Please ask, why did the Germinal Organization come to the Novice Villages to capture people?"

"I've been brainwashed. My faction is locked, and even my favorability is gone. How did this happen?"

"The NPC cut me into pieces and asked me about my background …"

"Me too!"

"Is this an unexpected plot? But I don't have any interface notifications."

The players recorded the actions of the Germinal Organization in the Novice Villages. The fully armed Germinal Organization soldiers handcuffed the players one by one. Some players resisted, and the Germinal Organization soldiers shot them directly. The bullets were tranquilizers.

A bunch of players were handcuffed and sat in the carriage. It was very crowded. Only the railings of the carriage door could see the outside world. It was like a prison cell.

Then, these players were brought to the Germinal Organization bases. On the Andrea Continent, the Germinal Organization bases were not as secretive as the bases in the other three continents. Every base of the headquarters was very large, ostentatious, and heavily guarded.

The land of the Andrea Continent was bare and brown. If one looked down from a satellite, they would see that the Germinal Organization bases were black areas scattered on the yellow land, like infected patches. This abandoned continent was full of radiation and dust, and life was withering. The Germinal Organization took over many old country ruins and inherited many facilities, including the former military forbidden zones.

"The Inhuman Incident has begun." Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He had experienced this incident in his previous life. It had caused a lot of discussion among the players, and it was the hottest topic at that time.

The curiosity of the NPCs toward the players was the core attraction of Galaxy. The existence of the players was a part of the story. Every novice planet showed different attitudes toward the players, and now, Blue Star was the earliest sign of this incident.

In the past, Han Xiao watched the show as a player. Now that he had a different perspective, he felt that he should be able to see something else.

"I made the Germinal Organization lose all of their bases. Fewer players will join their faction. The Germinal Organization will probably realize how big of a loss they have suffered." He felt very happy when he imagined the scene of the leader being angry.

Turning on the computer, Han Xiao browsed the information on the dark net. The existence of the players had been noticed by more forces. The natives of Blue Star were surprised by this group of uninvited guests.

"I think the Six Nations will take action soon. This way, the expedition war will be delayed for a while, but it will be much earlier than in my previous life."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. There were pros and cons to bringing forward the war. The good thing was that the players had not grown up yet. When the Six Nations and the Germinal Organization clashed head-on, the role of the players would be greatly reduced, and there would be fewer unexpected factors. With the Six Nations' strength, as long as the players did not cause trouble, they would be able to beat the Germinal Organization.
